description_zh: 只读规划：在改代码前产出实现思路、关键文件与风险。
description_en: Read-only planner that proposes an implementation approach and critical files before editing.
when_to_use: Use before multi-file or ambiguous edits to produce an actionable plan: goal, critical files, ordered steps, risks, and verification commands. Read-only. Do not use for tiny single-file patches.
